from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CaseNumberInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted case numbers mentioned in the judgment (cited or current)."""
    number: str = Field(description="The full case number string, e.g. (2020) 最高法知民终 1447 号")
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The court issuing or mentioned in the case number")
    instance_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="The instance of the case (e.g. 一审，二审，再审) based on context")

class PartyInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted party information from the judgment."""
    name: str = Field(description="The name of the party involved")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(description="The role in the case (e.g. 上诉人，被上诉人，原告，被告)")
    is_applicant: bool = Field(description="Whether this party is the one filing the appeal/retrial/objection")

class FeeDetail(BaseModel):
    """Extracted litigation fee information."""
    fee_type: str = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g. 一审案件受理费，二审受理费")
    amount: str = Field(description="The fee amount including currency unit, e.g. 53166 元")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g. 朱某磊，某某（深圳）科技有限公司")

class RulingAction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted ruling actions or orders."""
    action: str = Field(description="The action taken (e.g. 撤销，维持，驳回，准许撤回，支付)")
    target: Optional[str] = Field(description="What the action targets (e.g. 原判决，诉讼请求，上诉)")
    monetary_amount: Optional[str] = Field(description="If payment is involved, the amount, e.g. 420 万元")

class CauseOfAction(BaseModel):
    """Legal cause of action or dispute type."""
    cause: str = Field(description="The legal cause or dispute type, e.g. 侵害实用新型专利权纠纷，继承纠纷")

class CourtInfo(BaseModel):
    """Court names mentioned in the document."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the court")
    role: str = Field(description="Role of the court in this document (e.g. Issuing Court, Lower Court)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted evidence fields for a single document."""
    case_numbers: List[CaseNumberInfo] = Field(description="List of case numbers found in the document")
    parties: List[PartyInfo] = Field(description="List of all parties mentioned with their roles")
    fees: List[FeeDetail] = Field(description="List of all litigation fee details and bearers")
    rulings: List[RulingAction] = Field(description="List of the court's explicit orders and decisions")
    causes: List[CauseOfAction] = Field(description="The type of legal dispute involved")
    courts: List[CourtInfo] = Field(description="List of courts mentioned")
